summary: Product Editor Tahap 3 (duplicate, autosave, bulk price/stock/status, Excel import/export) tested end to end. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass, plus one extra admin preview-import check on a legacy PGS product with no weight: it gave 'update', made no DB write, and the price stayed 915000. Frontend (390x844 mobile web): all tested flows pass. Seller list: search, 4 filters, select-all, bulk price, stock and status with the result dialog, % validation, duplicate opening the editor with '(Salinan)'. Ekspor Excel and Unduh Template downloads. Import dialog: a .txt file is rejected; xlsx preview then apply shows Diubah 1 / Draft 1 and the list updates. Admin: 5 store pills, 6.618 products, switching store, search, pagination 30->70->90. Editor: autosave shows '✓ Draft tersimpan otomatis' after about 4s. Repeat edits reuse the same draft. pe-drafts appears after reload. pe-duplicate shows on existing products. pe-resume-draft appears after leaving an edited product, and Lanjutkan opens the draft. Publish, Simpan & Tambah Baru and Simpan Draft all work, and autosave leaves no duplicate or orphan drafts after publish. No critical bugs. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

minor.issue: A new row (no ID) that has only a number (e.g. just Stok) and no name, category or photo is still saved as a draft '(tanpa nama)'. Stray cells in a sheet create junk drafts. Consider skipping rows with no name, no images and no description.
A blank cell means 'unchanged', so an existing discount cannot be removed by clearing 'Harga Diskon' in Excel. Document this in Panduan, or accept 0 as 'remove discount'.

product_ids max_length=500 returns a raw pydantic 422. The UI lets the user select more than 500 rows after scrolling (select-all only selects the rows already loaded). Show a friendly message or cap selection at 500 in the UI.

issues: The fixed header (store pills, 3 action buttons wrapping to 2 lines, search, filters, select-all) takes about 400px, about half the screen. Only about 4 rows are visible. Consider putting the header in the FlatList ListHeaderComponent so it scrolls away, or making the actions more compact.
The pe-autosave label is cut off ('✓ Draft tersimpan ot…') because it shares a row with Batalkan and Preview. The bottom bar takes about 190px on 390px wide screens.

The 'Batalkan perubahan?' dialog says unsaved changes will be lost, but autosave has already kept them as a draft (pe-drafts / pe-resume-draft shows them later). Either delete the autosaved draft when the user confirms, or change the message.

react_native_issues.issue: src/utils/download.ts:2 imports expo-file-system (File/Paths API), but it is not declared in package.json. It only resolves as a transitive dependency (node_modules 58.0.10). Reference: /app/frontend/src/utils/download.ts:2

action_items: Optional: run `npx expo install expo-file-system` so the dependency used in src/utils/download.ts is declared and pinned explicitly
Optional: import should skip rows that have no name, images or description instead of saving '(tanpa nama)' drafts

Optional: cap bulk selection at 500 or show a friendly error; make the list header scroll away on mobile; fix the pe-autosave label truncation; align the cancel-confirm message with autosave behaviour
critical_code_review_comments: Autosave race handling is correct: draftRef plus awaiting savingRef in saveDraft and publish means autosave drafts are reused and deleted on publish. Verified via network capture.
Bulk edit only $sets price/stock/variants/status fields, so legacy catalogue products without weight are not blocked or changed in other fields. Good.
Import update validation only covers changed fields (the owns() filter), so old incomplete catalogue rows can still get price/stock updates. Good.
product_bulk.py (415 lines) and product_editor.py (396 lines) are both under 700 lines.
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ products and drafts for seller acct1 (Bulk/Imp/UI27). All of them were removed; 0 left over verified. The shared PGS catalogue was not modified (only an admin preview import with commit=false was run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -n 0 (serial). xdist parallel runs cause count assertion races in test_import_roundtrip. Export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. For UI: `python tests/ui_iter27_helper.py create > /tmp/ui27.json` prints the seller and admin tokens plus 2 product ids; `clean` removes TEST_UI27 data. Open /seller, wait 3s, set localStorage pgs_auth_token, then reload before deep-linking. Setting the token while the app is still booting caused a one-off 'Not authenticated'. Import on web: page.expect_file_chooser on import-pick, then set_files.
